bugs.summary: removeItem splices index -1 when the sku is missing, removing the last line instead of doing nothing
total subtracts the percentage as cents instead of applying a percentage discount
sortByPrice sorts the input in place instead of returning a new array
paginate treats page as 0-based: page 1 skips the first pageSize items
readReceipt never checks that name stays inside receiptsDir
saveOrder doesn't await db.write, so it resolves early and write failures escape the catch
